# Data Source: stripe_balance

The account's current balance, by currency. It has no arguments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_balance" "current" {}

output "available_usd" {
  value = [for b in data.stripe_balance.current.available : b.amount if b.currency == "usd"]
}
```

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes:

* `available` - Available funds that you can transfer or pay out automatically by Stripe or explicitly through the [Transfers API](https://docs.stripe.com/api#transfers) or [Payouts API](https://docs.stripe.com/api#payouts). You can find the available balance for each currency and payment type in the `source_types` property. See [`available`](#available) below.
* `connect_reserved` - Funds held due to negative balances on connected accounts where [account.controller.requirement_collection](https://docs.stripe.com/api/accounts/object#account_object-controller-requirement_collection) is `application`, which includes Custom accounts. You can find the connect reserve balance for each currency and payment type in the `source_types` property. See [`connect_reserved`](#connect_reserved) below.
* `instant_available` - Funds that you can pay out using Instant Payouts. See [`instant_available`](#instant_available) below.
* `issuing` - See [`issuing`](#issuing) below.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `pending` - Funds that aren't available in the balance yet. You can find the pending balance for each currency and each payment type in the `source_types` property. See [`pending`](#pending) below.
* `refund_and_dispute_prefunding` - See [`refund_and_dispute_prefunding`](#refund_and_dispute_prefunding) below.

<a id="available"></a>
### `available`

The `available` attribute is a list. Each element supports:

* `amount` - Balance amount.
* `currency` - Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).
* `source_types` - See [`available.source_types`](#available.source_types) below.

<a id="available.source_types"></a>
### `available.source_types`

The `available.source_types` attribute supports:

* `bank_account` - Amount coming from [legacy US ACH payments](https://docs.stripe.com/ach-deprecated).
* `card` - Amount coming from most payment methods, including cards as well as [non-legacy bank debits](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/bank-debits).
* `fpx` - Amount coming from [FPX](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/fpx), a Malaysian payment method.
